geometry: derived from GameApp/Hud.cpp arithmetic by derive_layouts.py; not dumped from the game (no build in this container). Elements with measured:false depend on DirectWrite text measurement (ADR-061) and are estimated.
drawOrder: layer -1 (entity bars) first; then layer 0 (HUD) and each window layer back to front; within a layer every 'panels' element (panel/outline/bar/button) in order, then 'lines', then 'sprites', then 'texts' (Hud.h:714-760, GameClient.cpp:1289-1338).
notes: Back to front in the order opened: production (slot 0), research (slot 1), designer (Hud.cpp:3634-3687; WindowManager.cpp:99-114).

Over the busy state: the windows show its 2,350 Ore, its research (Hull Plating done; Large Hull 62% at the front, then Improved Extraction and Mass Driver Calibration) and Hull Plating's hull hit points in the designer (253, 575 and 1,380 HP).
Shipyard 01 is the idle one, having built 14 ships; Shipyard 02 builds the Swarm.
Hit points: 6 Swarm at 227.7 and 6 Medium-hull ships at 517.5 with Hull Plating, a maximum of 4,472; the per-ship bars are the ships' shares of theirs and add up to the line's figure.
Two sample entity bars over the world (layer -1, drawn under every panel): a hurt structure, and a site 40% built at 46% of its hit points.

Sectors: A3 is cut off because A2 is not held; C2's Relay is suppressed. Map content is seed 342's, a sample (a match's seed is the clock, WinMain.cpp:134-139): the 7 sectors pirates guard at the start of every match, camps on the contested pairs D1/B5 and E2/A4 and strongholds on the rich pair E1/A5 and the center C3 (Map.json outposts; Map.cpp:421-440; ADR-072 d7, ADR-073); and all 40 ore asteroids, Map.json's 6 home ones and the 34 the seed places by Map.json sectorKinds and placement (Map.cpp:381-419), drawn under the fog since the map's asteroids are always seen (Simulation.cpp:245-247; Hud.cpp:3486-3528). A held sector shows its Relay on its node, and each rig the income implies stands on its asteroid.
